answer: The kernel counter is kept in nebula and haven publishes each reset. Anyone therefore has to keep every alias continuously active for 28 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A bond is refunded only after 28 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. A farm of 4921 identities would post 1415 proofs and burn roughly 12 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
